title: Probleme zu Hause

chapters.title: Kannst du das reparieren?
chapters.translation: می تونی این را تعمیر کنی؟
chapters.focus: reparieren + asking whether a repair is possible

chapters.title: Ich rufe den Techniker an
chapters.focus: controlled separable anrufen + contacting repair service

chapters.title: Wann kann er kommen?
chapters.focus: reuse appointment negotiation for a technician visit

chapters.title: Das Problem ist gelöst
chapters.focus: module synthesis and resolved home problem

pedagogy: Start by identifying and describing a malfunction. Then ask about repair, contact a technician, arrange a visit, and finish with a complete resolved-problem story. Grammar stays contextual and builds mostly on already-known modal and appointment patterns.
